clue.text: Wealthy doctor describes working in state capital

parts.note: wealthy means rich

indicators.note: to describe a circle is to draw round, so the doctor goes around the next piece

parts.note: MD is Doctor of Medicine
a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: A rich physician is busy at work in the seat of a state government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describes' is used in the geometric sense of drawing round, not of telling about.
explanation.definitionFit: Richmond is the capital city of the US state of Virginia.

clue.text: Meal's about finished

parts.note: re is a Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning
something finished is over and past

explanation.surface: A dinner has just come to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: A repast is a formal word for a meal or feast.

clue.text: Cold? One could make a spicy dish

parts.note: a chill is a coldness
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A cook wonders whether something cold could become a hot plate of food.
explanation.definitionFit: Chilli con carne, usually just called chilli, is a spicy meat stew.

clue.text: Spoil old lady and youth with English jam

parts.note: to mar something is to spoil it
old lady is informal for mother, MA
a lad is a youth

explanation.surface: Someone spoils a grandmother and a boy by giving them English preserves.
explanation.definitionFit: Marmalade is a citrus preserve, a kind of jam made with oranges.

clue.text: Warning broadcast on it, announcer initially breaking story

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered abroad, so the letters of on it are spread into a new order
the first letter breaks into the story, sitting inside it

parts.note: a story is a piece of fiction

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of announcer

explanation.surface: A radio warning goes out, with the announcer just starting to break a news story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' scrambles the two words into NOTI; 'Warning' is the definition, not 'story'.
explanation.definitionFit: A notification is a formal notice, which can serve as a warning given in advance.

clue.text: Got the shakes in run-down part of town

indicators.note: something that gets the shakes trembles, so these letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: Someone started trembling in a poor district of a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shakes' turns GOT THE into the six letters needed.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghetto is a poor, densely populated, run-down quarter of a city.

clue.text: Grating last of Cheddar into mince

indicators.note: into means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: hash is chopped or minced meat

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of Cheddar

explanation.surface: A cook grates the end of a block of Cheddar cheese over minced meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last of' gives R, which goes 'into' HASH. Cheddar is a British cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: A grating sound is harsh, rough and unpleasant to the ear.

clue.text: Conjectures made by politicians entertaining ambassador

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to hold them within, so the politicians go around the ambassador

parts.note: Tories are members of the UK Conservative Party
HE, His Excellency, is the form of address for an ambassador

explanation.surface: Politicians hosting a foreign envoy come up with guesses.
explanation.walkthrough: HE stands for His Excellency, the formal title of an ambassador; 'entertaining' means hosting.
explanation.definitionFit: Theories are conjectures, ideas proposed to explain something but not proven.

clue.text: Royal autobiography, not appearing all at once?

definitions.meaning: royals call themselves one, so a royal's memoir would be a book about one written by one

explanation.surface: A king's memoir is being published in instalments.
explanation.definitionFit: One by one means individually in succession; a royal using the regal one would write a life of one by one.

clue.text: In religious house it is the most important thing

indicators.note: in means the word it sits inside the religious house

parts.note: a priory is a house of monks or nuns

explanation.surface: In a monastery, something is said to matter more than anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A priority is the thing that takes precedence over all others.

clue.text: Recited flourishing-novelist

indicators.note: something recited is spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: plants that are flourishing are green and verdant

explanation.surface: A thriving writer gives a reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Graham Greene was an English novelist, author of Brighton Rock.

clue.text: Washington Heights?

parts.note: looks like the Manhattan neighbourhood, but reads as a lofty peak found in Washington State

explanation.surface: A question about a district of upper Manhattan.
explanation.definitionFit: Mount Rainier is the highest peak in Washington State, a literal height there.

clue.text: Dance with girl with it'

parts.note: Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally
it is slang for sex appeal, abbreviated SA

explanation.surface: Someone dances with a girl who has plenty of charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a lively Latin American dance.

clue.text: Impulsive jester, comedian

parts.note: a court jester was a fool
Oliver Hardy was the comedian partnered with Stan Laurel

explanation.surface: A list of clowns: a reckless jester and a comic.
explanation.definitionFit: Foolhardy means rashly bold, acting impulsively without thought of risk.

clue.text: Moving to the music, group making record

parts.note: moving to music is dancing
Queen was the British rock group fronted by Freddie Mercury

explanation.surface: People sway to music while a band cuts a disc.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moving to the music' looks like the definition; it is just the first piece, and the definition is 'record'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dancing Queen is a hit record by ABBA from 1976.

clue.text: Trouble during first half of reel after square dance

indicators.note: after means the following piece comes later than the square

parts.note: a quad is a quadrangle, a square courtyard

indicators.note: during means the trouble sits inside the next piece
first half of takes the opening two letters of reel

parts.note: ill means trouble or misfortune

explanation.surface: Problems arise during a reel at a square dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'square dance' looks like one phrase, but square is a piece and the dance alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A quadrille is a square dance for four couples, popular in the nineteenth century.

clue.text: One making toast with reference to a departing Queen

indicators.note: departing means the letter a leaves the phrase

parts.note: apropos means with reference to
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Someone raises a glass about a monarch who is leaving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'departing' strips the A off the front of the French-derived word for with reference to, leaving PROPOS.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposer of a toast is the person who invites guests to drink to someone.

clue.text: A party overcomes tricky point in formal selection of candidate?

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece that overcomes another sits above it

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: tricky suggests the letters of point are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A group of political supporters gets over a difficult point while choosing a candidate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tricky' turns POINT into PTION, placed under ADO because ADO 'overcomes' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoption is the formal choosing of a candidate by a party to stand in an election.

clue.text: Memorable event from New Year involving theologian screening message

indicators.note: involving means the shuffled year holds the next piece within it
new means the letters of year are made into a fresh word
screening means one piece hides another inside it

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian
a letter is a written message

explanation.surface: A special occasion comes from New Year when a religious scholar hides a note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' makes READY from the year; the theologian's DD and the message nest inside it, red letters marking saints' days.
explanation.definitionFit: A red-letter day is a special day to remember, from feast days marked in red on calendars.

clue.text: Writing to the Spanish composer

parts.note: a person's hand is their handwriting
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Someone writes to a Spanish musician.
explanation.definitionFit: George Frideric Handel was the German-born composer of Messiah.

clue.text: Short journey announced that crosses Siberia

indicators.note: announced means spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a step is a short distance or journey

explanation.surface: A brief trip across Siberia is broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: The steppe is the vast grassy plain stretching across Siberia and Central Asia.

clue.text: Sausage one must have seasoning on first

parts.note: pepper is a common seasoning
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A diner insists a sausage be seasoned beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on first' means the seasoning and ON come before the one, not after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy Italian-American dried sausage.

clue.text: Woman not wholly above the law?

indicators.note: not wholly says only part of these words is used, a run inside them

explanation.surface: A question whether some woman considers herself not entirely beyond the law.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'abovE THE Law'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethel is a woman's given name.

clue.text: Respond concerning deed

parts.note: re means concerning
a deed is an act

explanation.surface: Reply about something someone did.
explanation.definitionFit: To react is to respond to something that happens.

clue.text: Small son, delicate

parts.note: light means delicate or not heavy

explanation.surface: A description of a little, fragile boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Slight means small in size or slender in build.

clue.text: Depressed about misfortune, prepared for long drive

indicators.note: about means the depressed piece goes around the misfortune

parts.note: fed up means depressed or discontented
ill means misfortune or harm

explanation.surface: Someone gloomy about bad luck gets ready for a long car journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts ILL inside FED UP, after F.
explanation.definitionFit: A car filled up with fuel has a full tank, ready for a long drive.

clue.text: Cause resentment in joint after stripper's finale

indicators.note: after means the joint comes following the letter
finale picks out the last letter of stripper's

parts.note: the ankle is a joint

explanation.surface: A dancer's closing act strains a joint and causes bitterness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finale' gives R, the last letter of stripper (the 's adds no letter).
explanation.definitionFit: To rankle is to cause lasting irritation or bitterness.

clue.text: Right-winger levelled — what do we hear ref did?

parts.note: a wall built true is level and straight

indicators.note: a question about what is heard means the word is taken as spoken

parts.note: a referee blew the whistle

explanation.surface: A conservative is straightened out, and someone asks what the referee did.
explanation.walkthrough: TRUE BLUE means a staunch Conservative in Britain, from the party's blue colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A true blue is a staunch loyal Conservative, the party whose colour is blue.
